entries.en: Our friends in Ariake sent back the sketchbook we had left behind.
entries.zh: 有明的朋友们寄回了我们忘在那里的速写本。

entries.en: Arianna tested the folding chair before offering it to the elderly visitor.
entries.zh: 阿里安娜先试了试折叠椅，才请那位年长的访客使用。

entries.en: Feelgood covered the unfinished painting before opening the dusty cupboard.
entries.zh: 菲尔古德先盖好那幅未完成的画，再打开积满灰尘的柜子。

entries.en: Foody checked the hall for anything the musicians might have forgotten.
entries.zh: 富迪在大厅里检查，看乐手们有没有落下东西。

entries.en: The class compared two accounts of the Moral Majority before discussing their different emphases.
entries.zh: 课堂上，大家先比较了两篇关于争取道德多数运动的记述，再讨论各自的侧重点。

entries.en: The research team compared two actins using the same measurement procedure.
entries.zh: 研究团队用同一套测量流程比较了两种肌动蛋白。

entries.en: The report compared the genetic sequences of several adenoviruses.
entries.zh: 报告比较了几种腺病毒的基因序列。

entries.en: The lecture compared the embryos of several amniotes using enlarged drawings.
entries.zh: 讲座用放大的图画比较了几种羊膜动物的胚胎。

entries.en: The class compared two amylases in the same starch experiment.
entries.zh: 课堂上，大家在同一项淀粉实验中比较了两种淀粉酶。

entries.en: The lecturer discussed arboviruses after introducing the role of insects in disease transmission.
entries.zh: 讲师先介绍了昆虫在疾病传播中的作用，随后讨论了虫媒病毒。

entries.en: The paper distinguishes medicines used prophylactically from those used to treat an existing illness.
entries.zh: 论文区分了用于预防的药物与用于治疗已有疾病的药物。

entries.en: The report listed the serotype but did not identify the patient's source of infection.
entries.zh: 报告列出了血清型，却没有确定这名患者的感染源。

entries.en: The demonstration used luminol to produce a blue glow in a darkened room.
entries.zh: 演示在调暗的房间里用鲁米诺产生了蓝色辉光。

entries.en: The lecture distinguished necrotizing inflammation from changes that did not involve tissue death.
entries.zh: 讲座区分了引起坏死的炎症与不涉及组织死亡的变化。

entries.en: The case discussion showed how difficult it was to prognose the disease.
entries.zh: 病例讨论表明，要预测这种疾病的结局有多困难。

entries.en: In the historical novel, the physician hopes to abirritate the patient's sensitive skin.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说中，医生希望减轻患者敏感皮肤所受的刺激。

entries.en: The diagram shows fungal cells that abstrict spores from their tips.
entries.zh: 图中展示了从顶端缢离出孢子的真菌细胞。
